name: Aaron Valente
source:
Aaron is one of the four Valente's brothers, a well-known and noble family in the makai, which controls the element of fire. He's very friendly, caring and likes Yuri's cooking.
He's Henrietta's childhood friend and unlike his brothers he can control light.
